themes.name: One Dark & One Light
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: A coder's favourite for writing: One Light by day and One Dark at night, blue links, headings stepping through purple, blue, green and gold, and code in the same colours. On the Atom One palettes.

themes.name: Rosé Pine
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Soft and natural: Rosé Pine Dawn's warm paper by day and Rosé Pine's deep night after dark, iris accents, pine links and rose quotes. On the Rosé Pine palette.

themes.name: Solarized
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Calm, low-glare colours for long reading: Solarized's warm light page by day and its deep blue-green one at night, blue links, cyan and green headings and orange code. On the Solarized palette.

themes.name: Tokyo Night
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Clear and electric: Tokyo Night Day's pale blue page by day and the Night palette after dark, blue headings, purple and cyan accents, and code in the same colours. On the Tokyo Night palette.

themes.name: Cards
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: For notes you keep in order: quotes, code, tables and callouts each sit in a rounded card on a softly tinted page, and level-2 headings open a section over a rule. After the Border theme's card layout, our own CSS.

themes.name: Compact
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: More on a screen without crowding it: a 15 px sans with tight lines and paragraphs, small headings set apart by weight rather than size, and lists that sit close. For lists, logs and quick notes. After Shimmering Focus's density, our own CSS.

themes.name: Contrast
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Clear for long reading and tired eyes: near-black on white by day and white on near-black at night, 18 px type, links always underlined, a firm rule under top headings and code set apart by a border. Meets WCAG AAA for body text. After ITS's legibility, our own CSS.

themes.name: Outline
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: For plans, to-dos and outlines: a light, open sans, headings in calm blue, bullets and numbers in the accent colour, and list items with room between them so each one reads as a step. After Things' clean look, our own CSS.

themes.name: Reading Room
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Like reading a well-set book: a large serif on warm paper, wide lines and generous paragraphs, bold in deep red, italics in blue and links in amber; a lamp-lit brown page after dark. After Primary's warm palette, our own CSS.

themes.name: Misty
themes.author: myshzzx
themes.description: Misty from Typora, made over for Textus: soft green-to-blue headings, numbered sections and gentle callouts, one file that follows light and dark. After Misty by E-Tiger Studio (MIT), with ideas from VLOOK.

zh.description: 由 Typora 主题 Misty 改造（E-Tiger Studio, 2017-2020, MIT），同时参考 VLOOK：绿蓝渐变的标题、带编号的章节和柔和的提示块，一个文件跟随浅色与深色。

themes.name: Article
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Like a typeset paper: a Computer Modern style serif, numbered sections, booktabs tables and plain links, on white or on black. After LaTeX Typora by shamsghi.

zh.description: 像一篇排好版的论文：Computer Modern 风格的衬线字体、带编号的章节、三线表和朴素的链接，白底或黑底。参考 shamsghi 的 LaTeX Typora。

themes.name: Codex Mono
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: A writer's terminal: every word in a coding font, a centred title, one slate colour for headings, tinted quotes with a coloured bar and outlined highlights. After Drake by liangjingkanji.

zh.description: 写作者的终端：全文用等宽字体，标题居中，各级标题统一用石板灰，引用带底色和彩色竖条，高亮用描边。参考 liangjingkanji 的 Drake。

themes.name: Fjord
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Arctic and calm: a snow-storm page by day and polar night after dark, frost-blue links, a double quote rule, and aurora-coloured headings at night. On the Nord palette.

zh.description: 极地般平静：白天是雪暴般的浅色页，夜里是极夜，霜蓝色链接，双线引用，夜间标题带极光色。基于 Nord 配色。

themes.name: Inkpaper
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Ink on paper: a warm paper page and a near-black one, headings in ink, cyan links and quiet code. On Flexoki by Steph Ango, https://stephango.com/flexoki.

zh.description: 纸上的墨：温暖的纸色页和近黑的夜间页，标题如墨，链接为青色，代码低调。基于 Steph Ango 的 Flexoki，https://stephango.com/flexoki。

themes.name: Latte & Mocha
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Soft pastels for long sessions: a cool latte page by day and a deep mocha one at night, mauve accents, lavender quotes and a sapphire bold. An unofficial port of the Catppuccin palette.

zh.description: 适合长时间写作的柔和粉彩：白天是清爽的拿铁色，夜里是深摩卡色，淡紫点缀，薰衣草色引用，粗体为宝石蓝。Catppuccin 配色的非官方移植。

themes.name: Lazuli
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Indigo and clear: a centred title, level-2 headings on a solid blue band, serif headings over a sans body, blue bold and blue list markers. After Lapis by YiNN.

zh.description: 靛蓝而清爽：标题居中，二级标题衬在纯蓝色带上，标题用衬线、正文用无衬线，粗体和列表符号为蓝色。参考 YiNN 的 Lapis。

themes.name: Nosferatu
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Vivid and nocturnal: the classic dark purple-grey page with neon accents, and a warm cream day page with deeper ones. On the Dracula and Alucard palettes.

zh.description: 鲜明的夜色：经典的深紫灰夜间页配霓虹色点缀，白天是温暖的奶油色页、点缀更深。基于 Dracula 和 Alucard 配色。

themes.name: Retro Wood
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Warm and retro: a faded cream page and a dark wood one, a six-colour heading ladder, orange quotes and a golden bold. On the gruvbox palette.

zh.description: 温暖复古：褪色的奶油色页和深木色页，六级标题各有颜色，橙色引用，金色粗体。基于 gruvbox 配色。

themes.name: Tidepool
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Fresh and lively: level-2 headings on a mint pill, small markers before the smaller headings, a dashed rule and tinted quotes, with a calm sea-dark night. After Phycat by sumruler.

zh.description: 清新活泼：二级标题衬在薄荷色胶囊上，较小的标题前有小标记，虚线分隔，引用带底色，夜间是平静的深海色。参考 sumruler 的 Phycat。

themes.name: Plain
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: Textus's default look without the heading marks: the same type and colours, with plain level-3 and level-4 headings.

zh.description: Textus 默认外观去掉标题标记：字体和颜色相同，三级和四级标题不带标记。

themes.name: Manuscript
themes.author: CatVinci-Studio
themes.description: A typewritten draft: typewriter type on off-white paper, a narrow page, uppercase headings with section marks and a ribbon-red accent.

zh.description: 打字机草稿：米白纸上的打字机字体，页面窄，标题大写并带章节符号，点缀色为色带红。
